title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
abstract_first: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas.
